title.zh: 卷九 本紀第九 後廢帝
title.raw: 卷九 本紀第九 後廢帝 Volume 9 Annals 9: Emperor Fei II

sentences.zh: 廢帝諱昱，字德融，小字慧震，明帝長子也。

translations.literal: The Deposed Emperor of the Later reign had the taboo name Yu; his courtesy name was Derong and his childhood name Huizhen. He was Emperor Ming's eldest son.
translations.idiomatic: The Deposed Emperor of the Later reign was named Yu, courtesy name Derong, childhood name Huizhen. He was the eldest son of Emperor Ming.

sentences.zh: 大明七年正月辛丑，生於衞尉府。

translations.literal: In the first month of the seventh year of Daming, on xinchou day, he was born in the Commandant's residence.
translations.idiomatic: He was born on xinchou day in the first month of the seventh year of Daming at the Commandant's residence.

sentences.zh: 太宗諸子在孕，皆以周易筮之，即以所得之卦為小字，故帝字慧震，其餘皇子亦如之。

translations.literal: When Emperor Ming's sons were still in the womb, all were divined with the Book of Changes; the hexagram obtained became the childhood name—hence the emperor's childhood name Huizhen—and the other princes likewise.
translations.idiomatic: While Emperor Ming's sons were still in the womb, each was divined with the Book of Changes, and the hexagram obtained became his childhood name; hence the emperor's childhood name Huizhen, and the other princes followed the same practice.

sentences.zh: 泰始二年，立為皇太子。

translations.literal: In the second year of Taishi he was installed as crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Taishi he was named crown prince.

sentences.zh: 三年，始制太子改名昱。

translations.literal: In the third year regulations were first established for the crown prince to change his name to Yu.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year regulations were first issued requiring the crown prince to take the name Yu.

sentences.zh: 安車乘象輅。

translations.literal: He rode in the peace chariot and the elephant-drawn carriage.
translations.idiomatic: He was granted use of the peace chariot and the elephant-drawn imperial carriage.

sentences.zh: 六年，出東宮。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he moved out to the Eastern Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he took up residence in the Eastern Palace.

sentences.zh: 又制太子元正朝賀，服袞冕九章衣。

translations.literal: Regulations were also set that for the crown prince's New Year's court audience he would wear the nine-symbol robe with round cap and tassels.
translations.idiomatic: Regulations were also issued that at the crown prince's New Year's court audience he would wear the nine-emblem robe with round cap and tassels.

sentences.zh: 泰豫元年四月己亥，太宗崩。

translations.literal: On jihai day in the fourth month of the first year of Taiyu, Emperor Ming died.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day in the fourth month of the first year of Taiyu Emperor Ming died.

sentences.zh: 庚子，太子即皇帝位，大赦天下。

translations.literal: On gengzi day the crown prince assumed the imperial position and proclaimed a general amnesty throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day the crown prince ascended the throne and proclaimed a general amnesty throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 尚書令袁粲、護軍將軍褚淵共輔朝政。

translations.literal: Director of the Masters of Writing Yuan Can and General of the Guard Chu Yuan jointly assisted in governing the court.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Can, Director of the Masters of Writing, and Chu Yuan, General of the Guard, jointly assisted in governing the court.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，以護軍將軍張永為右光祿大夫，撫軍將軍安成王為揚州刺史。

translations.literal: On yisi day General of the Guard Zhang Yong was made Right Grandee for Splendid Virtue, and General Who Tranquilizes the Army Prince of Ancheng was made Inspector of Yangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day General of the Guard Zhang Yong was made right grandee for splendid virtue, and General Who Tranquilizes the Army Prince of Ancheng was appointed inspector of Yangzhou.

sentences.zh: 己酉，特進、右光祿大夫劉遵考改為左光祿大夫。

translations.literal: On jiyou day Special Advanced Grandee and Right Grandee for Splendid Virtue Liu Zun-kao was changed to Left Grandee for Splendid Virtue.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day Special Advanced Grandee and Right Grandee for Splendid Virtue Liu Zun-kao was transferred to left grandee for splendid virtue.

sentences.zh: 五月丁巳，以吳興太守張岱為益州刺史。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on dingsi day, Administrator of Wuxing Zhang Dai was made Inspector of Yizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day in the fifth month Administrator of Wuxing Zhang Dai was appointed inspector of Yizhou.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，緣江戍兵老疾者，悉聽還。

translations.literal: On wuchen day soldiers garrisoned along the river who were old or ill were all permitted to return home.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day garrison troops stationed along the river who were aged or infirm were all permitted to return home.

sentences.zh: 班劍依舊入殿。

translations.literal: Those bearing swords of office entered the hall as before.
translations.idiomatic: Officials granted the privilege of bearing swords in court entered the hall as before.

sentences.zh: 六月壬辰，詔曰：「夫興王經制，實先民隱，方求廣教，刑於四維。

translations.literal: On renchen day in the sixth month an edict said: "The founding king's canonical institutions truly arise from the people's hidden needs; now we seek broadly to spread instruction and set it as law in the four quarters.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day in the sixth month an edict declared: "The canonical institutions of a founding king truly spring from the people's hidden needs; we now seek to spread instruction broadly and make it law in the four quarters.

sentences.zh: 朕以煢眇，夙膺寶歷，永言民政，未接聽覽，眷言乃顧，無忘鑒寐。

translations.literal: I, lone and slight, from early age have received the precious succession; long have I spoken of civil affairs yet not yet heard and examined them myself; turning my thoughts again and again, I forget neither while awake nor in dreams to take them as my mirror.
translations.idiomatic: I, young and alone, have from early youth received the precious succession; though I have long spoken of civil affairs, I have not yet heard and reviewed them myself; turning my thoughts again and again, I forget neither waking nor sleeping to take them as my mirror.

sentences.zh: 可遣大使分行四方，觀採風謠，問其疾苦。

translations.literal: Let envoys be dispatched to travel separately through the four directions, observe and gather popular songs and rumors, and inquire into people's suffering.
translations.idiomatic: Let envoys be dispatched to travel separately through the four directions, observe and gather popular songs and rumors, and inquire into the people's hardships.

sentences.zh: 令有咈民，法不便俗者，悉各條奏。

translations.literal: Wherever laws displease the people or fail to accord with custom, let each case be listed and reported separately.
translations.idiomatic: Wherever laws displease the people or fail to suit local custom, let each case be listed and reported separately.

sentences.zh: 若守宰威恩可紀，廉勤允著，依事騰聞。

translations.literal: If prefects and magistrates have meritorious authority and grace worthy of record, or manifest probity and diligence, let reports be sent according to the facts.
translations.idiomatic: If prefects and magistrates have authority and grace worthy of record, or show manifest probity and diligence, let reports on them be sent according to the facts.

sentences.zh: 如獄訟誣枉，職事紕繆，惰公存私，害民利己者，無或隱昧。

translations.literal: If lawsuits involve false accusations, official duties are mishandled, public service is neglected for private gain, or the people are harmed for one's own benefit, let nothing be concealed.
translations.idiomatic: If lawsuits involve false accusations, official duties are mishandled, public service is shirked for private gain, or the people are harmed for personal profit, let nothing be concealed.

sentences.zh: 廣納芻輿之議，博求獻藝之規。

translations.literal: Let cart-drivers' counsel be broadly received and plans for presenting talent widely sought.
translations.idiomatic: Let counsel from the humblest sources be broadly received and plans for presenting talent widely sought.

sentences.zh: 巡省之道，務令精洽，深簡行識，俾若朕親覽焉。

translations.literal: The route of inspection must be made thorough and precise; carefully select those of capacity and learning, so that it is as if I personally reviewed matters.
translations.idiomatic: The path of inspection must be made thorough and precise; carefully select men of capacity and learning, so that it is as if I personally reviewed matters.

sentences.zh: 」又詔曰：「夫寢夢期賢，往誥垂美，物色求良，前書稱盛。

translations.literal: " Again an edict said: "From dreams one anticipates the worthy; former injunctions have left beautiful examples; seeking out excellence, earlier writings spoke of flourishing.
translations.idiomatic: " Again an edict declared: "From dreams one anticipates the worthy; former injunctions have left fine examples; in seeking out excellence, earlier writings spoke of a flourishing age.

sentences.zh: 朕以沖昧，嗣膺寶業，思仰述聖猷，勉弘政道，興言多士，常想得人。

translations.literal: I, young and obscure, have succeeded to the precious enterprise; I think to follow and declare the sage's plan, strive to expand the path of governance, and when I speak of the many scholars, I constantly think of obtaining worthy men.
translations.idiomatic: I, young and untested, have succeeded to the precious enterprise; I wish to follow and proclaim the sage's design, strive to broaden the path of governance, and whenever I speak of the many scholars, I constantly think of finding the right men.

sentences.zh: 可普下牧守，廣加搜採。

translations.literal: Let this be broadly sent down to governors and prefects to search widely and gather them.
translations.idiomatic: Let this be sent down broadly to governors and prefects to search widely and gather them in.

sentences.zh: 其有孝友聞族，義讓光閭，或匿名屠釣，隱身耕牧，足以整厲澆風，扶益淳化者，凡厥一善，咸無遺逸。

translations.literal: Those whose filial piety and brotherly love are renowned in their clan, whose righteousness and forbearance shine throughout the hamlet, or who hide their names while butchering or fishing, concealing themselves in farming and herding—any who can rectify and encourage the diluted customs and support the pure transformation—every such virtue, let none be overlooked.
translations.idiomatic: Those whose filial piety and brotherly love are renowned in their clans, whose righteousness and forbearance shine throughout their hamlets, or who hide their names while butchering or fishing and conceal themselves in farming and herding—anyone who can stiffen diluted customs and support pure transformation—every such virtue, let none be overlooked.

sentences.zh: 虛輪佇帛，俟聞嘉薦。

translations.literal: Empty carriages wait with silk, awaiting word of excellent recommendations.
translations.idiomatic: Empty carriages stand ready with silk, awaiting word of worthy recommendations.

sentences.zh: 」京師雨水，詔賑卹二縣貧民。

translations.literal: " Rain caused flooding in the capital region; an edict ordered relief for the poor of two counties.
translations.idiomatic: " Rain caused flooding in the capital region, and an edict ordered relief for the poor of two counties.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，尊皇后曰皇太后，立皇后江氏。

translations.literal: On yisi day the empress was honored as empress dowager, and Lady Jiang was installed as empress.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day the empress was honored as empress dowager and Lady Jiang was installed as empress.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊辰，崇拜帝所生陳貴妃為皇太妃。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on wuchen day, the emperor's birth-mother Offered Consort Chen was honored as grand imperial consort.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day in the seventh month of autumn the emperor's birth-mother, Offered Consort Chen, was honored as grand imperial consort.

sentences.zh: 閏月丁亥，罷宋安郡還屬廣興。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month, on dinghai day, Song'an commandery was abolished and restored to Guangxing.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day in the intercalary month Song'an commandery was abolished and restored to Guangxing.

sentences.zh: 己丑，割南豫州南汝陰郡屬西豫州，西豫州廬江郡屬豫州。

translations.literal: On jichou day Nanruyin commandery of South Yuzhou was cut off and assigned to West Yuzhou, and Lujiang commandery of West Yuzhou was assigned to Yuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day Nanruyin commandery of South Yuzhou was transferred to West Yuzhou, and Lujiang commandery of West Yuzhou was transferred to Yuzhou.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，以新除征西將軍、開府儀同三司、荊州刺史蔡興宗為中書監、光祿大夫，安西將軍、郢州刺史沈攸之為鎮西將軍、荊州刺史，南徐州刺史劉秉為平西將軍、郢州刺史，新除太常建平王景素為鎮軍將軍、南徐州刺史。

translations.literal: On jiachen day the newly appointed General Who Campaigns West, Bearer of the Staff with Equal Protocol to the Three Ducal Ministers, and Inspector of Jingzhou Cai Xing-zong was made Supervisor of the Secretariat and Grandee for Splendid Virtue; General Who Pacifies the West and Inspector of Yingzhou Shen You-zhi was made General Who Tranquilizes the West and Inspector of Jingzhou; Inspector of South Xuzhou Liu Bing was made General Who Pacifies the West and Inspector of Yingzhou; and the newly appointed Director of Ceremonies Prince of Jianping Jing-su was made General Who Tranquilizes the Army and Inspector of South Xuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day newly appointed General Who Campaigns West, bearer of the staff with equal protocol to the Three Ducal Ministers, and inspector of Jingzhou Cai Xingzong was made supervisor of the secretariat and grandee for splendid virtue; General Who Pacifies the West and inspector of Yingzhou Shen Youzhi was made general who tranquilizes the west and inspector of Jingzhou; inspector of South Xuzhou Liu Bing was made general who pacifies the west and inspector of Yingzhou; and newly appointed director of ceremonies Prince of Jianping Jingsu was made general who tranquilizes the army and inspector of South Xuzhou.

sentences.zh: 冬十月辛卯，[1]撫軍將軍劉韞有罪免官。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on xinmao day, [1] the General Who Tranquilizes the Army Liu Yun was guilty of an offense and was dismissed from office.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day in the tenth month of winter, [1] General Who Tranquilizes the Army Liu Yun, having committed an offense, was dismissed from office.

sentences.zh: 辛未，護軍將軍褚淵母憂去職。

translations.literal: On xinwei day General of the Guard Chu Yuan left office due to his mother's mourning.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day General of the Guard Chu Yuan left office to observe mourning for his mother.

sentences.zh: 十一月己亥，新除平西將軍、郢州刺史劉秉為尚書左僕射。

translations.literal: On jihai day in the eleventh month, the newly appointed General Who Pacifies the West and Inspector of Yingzhou Liu Bing was made Left Vice-Director of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day in the eleventh month newly appointed General Who Pacifies the West and inspector of Yingzhou Liu Bing was made left vice-director of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，護軍將軍褚淵還攝本任。

translations.literal: On xinchou day General of the Guard Chu Yuan returned to hold his former post.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day General of the Guard Chu Yuan returned to hold his former post in an acting capacity.

sentences.zh: 芮芮國、高麗國遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: The states of Rouran and Goguryeo sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: The states of Rouran and Goguryeo sent envoys bearing tribute.

sentences.zh: 十二月，索虜寇義陽。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month the Northern Wei raided Yiyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month the Northern Wei invaded Yiyang.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，司州刺史王瞻擊破之。

translations.literal: On dingsi day Inspector of Sizhou Wang Zhan defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day Wang Zhan, inspector of Sizhou, routed them.

sentences.zh: 元徽元年春正月戊寅朔，改元，大赦天下。

translations.literal: On the first day of the first month of spring in the first year of Yuanhui, wuyin day, the era name was changed and a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day, the first day of the first month of spring in the first year of Yuanhui, the era name was changed and a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，詔曰：「夫緩法昭恩，裁風茂典，蠲憲貸眚，訓俗彝義。

translations.literal: On renyin day an edict said: "Clemency in law displays grace; curtailing excess is a flourishing standard; remitting punishment and pardoning offenses instructs the people in constant righteousness.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day an edict declared: "Clemency in law displays grace; curtailing excess is a flourishing standard; remitting punishment and pardoning offenses teaches the people constant righteousness.

sentences.zh: 朕臨馭宸樞，夤制氓宇，式存寬簡，思孚矜惠。

translations.literal: I preside over the imperial pivot and extend governance over the realm; I uphold leniency and simplicity and think to inspire compassionate kindness.
translations.idiomatic: I preside over the imperial pivot and extend governance across the realm; I uphold leniency and simplicity and seek to inspire compassionate kindness.

sentences.zh: 今開元肆宥，萬品惟新，凡茲流斥，宜均弘洗。

translations.literal: Now as the new era opens with broad forgiveness and the myriad categories are renewed, all those cast out and banished should equally receive expansive cleansing.
translations.idiomatic: Now, as the new era opens with broad forgiveness and the myriad ranks are renewed, all those cast out and banished should equally receive expansive pardon.

sentences.zh: 自元年以前貽罪徙放者，悉聽還本。」

translations.literal: All who before this inaugural year suffered punishment and exile are permitted to return to their original places."
translations.idiomatic: All who before this inaugural year suffered punishment and exile are permitted to return home."

sentences.zh: 二月乙亥，以晉熙王燮為郢州刺史。

translations.literal: In the second month, on yihai day, Prince of Jinxi Xie was made Inspector of Yingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day in the second month Prince of Jinxi Xie was appointed inspector of Yingzhou.

sentences.zh: 三月丙申，以撫軍長史何恢為廣州刺史。

translations.literal: In the third month, on bingshen day, Chief Clerk of the Army Who Tranquilizes the Army He Hui was made Inspector of Guangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day in the third month Chief Clerk of the Army Who Tranquilizes the Army He Hui was appointed inspector of Guangzhou.

sentences.zh: 婆利國遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: The state of Poli sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: The state of Poli sent envoys bearing tribute.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，以前淮南太守劉靈遺為南豫州刺史。

translations.literal: On wuxu day former Administrator of Huainan Liu Ling-yi was made Inspector of South Yuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day former administrator of Huainan Liu Lingyi was appointed inspector of South Yuzhou.

sentences.zh: 夏五月辛卯，以輔師將軍李安民為司州刺史。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of summer, on xinmao day, General Who Assists the Army Li An-min was made Inspector of Sizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day in the fifth month of summer General Who Assists the Army Li Anmin was appointed inspector of Sizhou.

sentences.zh: 丙申，河南王遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: On bingshen day the King of Henan sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day the King of Henan sent envoys bearing tribute.

sentences.zh: 六月壬子，以越州刺史陳伯紹為交州刺史。

translations.literal: On renzi day in the sixth month Inspector of Yuezhou Chen Bo-zhao was made Inspector of Jiaozhou.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day in the sixth month Inspector of Yuezhou Chen Bozhao was appointed inspector of Jiaozhou.

sentences.zh: [2]乙卯，特進、左光祿大夫劉遵考卒。

translations.literal: [2] Editorial note two stands in the received text at this point in the narrative. On yimao day Special Advanced Grandee and Left Grandee for Splendid Virtue Liu Zunkao died.
translations.idiomatic: [2] Editorial note two stands in the received text at this point in the narrative. On yimao day Special Advanced Grandee and Left Grandee for Splendid Virtue Liu Zunkao died.

sentences.zh: 壽陽大水，己未，遣殿中將軍賑卹慰勞。

translations.literal: Shouyang suffered great flooding; on jiwei day palace guards generals were dispatched to provide relief and offer consolation.
translations.idiomatic: Shouyang suffered severe flooding; on jiwei day palace guard generals were dispatched to provide relief and offer consolation.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，以左軍將軍孟次陽為兗州刺史。

translations.literal: On bingyin day General of the Left Army Meng Ci-yang was made Inspector of Yanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day General of the Left Army Meng Ciyang was appointed inspector of Yanzhou.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丁丑，散騎常侍顧長康、長水校尉何翌之表上所撰諫林，上自虞、舜，下及晉武，凡十二卷。

translations.literal: On dingchou day in the seventh month of autumn Attendant-in-Ordinary Gu Chang-kang and Commandant of the Long Water He Yi-zhi submitted memorials presenting the Admonition Forest they had compiled, from Yu and Shun down to Emperor Wu of Jin, twelve volumes in total.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day in the seventh month of autumn Attendant-in-Ordinary Gu Changkang and Commandant of the Long Water He Yizhi submitted the Admonition Forest they had compiled, from Yu and Shun down to Emperor Wu of Jin, twelve volumes in all.

sentences.zh: 八月辛亥，詔曰：「分方正俗，著自虞冊，川谷異制，煥乎姬典。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on xinhai day, an edict said: "Dividing territory and rectifying customs was set forth in the documents of Yu; differing institutions for valleys and rivers shine forth in the Zhou canon.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day in the eighth month an edict declared: "Dividing territory and rectifying customs was set forth in the records of Yu; differing institutions for valleys and rivers shine forth in the Zhou canon.

sentences.zh: 故井遂有辨，閭伍無雜，用能七教克宣，八政斯序。

translations.literal: Hence wells and paths were distinct and hamlet groups unmixed, enabling the Seven Teachings to be fully spread and the Eight Affairs duly ordered.
translations.idiomatic: Thus wells and paths were distinct and hamlet groups unmixed, enabling the Seven Teachings to be fully spread and the Eight Affairs duly ordered.

sentences.zh: 雖綿代殊軌，沿革異儀，或民懷遷俗，或國尚興徙，漢陽列燕、代之豪，關西熾齊、楚之族，並通籍新邑，即居成舊。

translations.literal: Though across long ages tracks differed and institutions changed, whether peoples cherished migration or states favored resettlement—at Hanyang were arrayed the magnates of Yan and Dai, in the west of the Pass flourished the clans of Qi and Chu—all registered in new settlements and dwelling there became longstanding.
translations.idiomatic: Though across long ages tracks differed and institutions changed, whether peoples cherished migration or states favored resettlement—at Hanyang stood the magnates of Yan and Dai, and west of the Pass flourished the clans of Qi and Chu—all registering in new settlements until residence there became old custom.

sentences.zh: 洎金行委御，禮樂南移，中州黎庶，襁負揚、越。

translations.literal: When the Jin line yielded the throne and rites and music moved south, the common people of the central provinces carried infants on their backs to Yang and Yue.
translations.idiomatic: When the Jin line yielded the throne and rites and music moved south, the common people of the central provinces carried infants on their backs to the Yang and Yue regions.

sentences.zh: 聖武造運，道一閎區，貽長世之規，申土斷之制。

translations.literal: When sacred martial prowess forged the destiny and the Way unified the broad realm, a plan for ages was bequeathed and the land-allocation system was enforced.
translations.idiomatic: When sacred martial prowess forged the destiny and the Way unified the broad realm, a lasting design was bequeathed and the land-allocation system was put into effect.

sentences.zh: 而夷險相因，盈晦遞襲，歲饉凋流，戎役惰散，違鄉寓境，漸至繁積。

translations.literal: Yet ease and hardship followed one another, fullness and decline succeeded in turn; famine years scattered the people, military service slackened and dispersed them; living apart from their home districts in foreign lands gradually piled up until the problem grew vast.
translations.idiomatic: Yet ease and hardship followed one another, fullness and decline succeeded in turn; famine years scattered the people and military service slackened and dispersed them; living apart from home districts in foreign lands gradually accumulated until the problem grew vast.

sentences.zh: 宜式遵鴻軌，以為永憲，庶阜俗昌民，反風定保。

translations.literal: It is fitting to take the great track as model and make it an eternal statute, so that customs may flourish, the people prosper, and the turning wind be stilled to secure stability.
translations.idiomatic: It is fitting to take the great track as model and make it an eternal statute, so that customs may flourish, the people prosper, and wayward trends be stilled to secure stability.

sentences.zh: 夷胥山之險，澄瀚海之波，括河圖於九服，振玉軔於五都矣。

translations.literal: The peril of Mount Xushan would be levelled, the waves of the vast sea cleared; the River Chart would be gathered within the nine domains and jade shafts would resound in the five capitals.
translations.idiomatic: The peril of Mount Xushan would be smoothed away, the waves of the vast sea stilled; the River Chart would be gathered within the nine domains and jade chariot shafts would resound in the five capitals.

sentences.zh: 」祕書丞王儉表上所撰七志三十卷。

translations.literal: " Secretary-in-Chief of the Palace Library Wang Jian submitted the Seven Records he had compiled, thirty volumes.
translations.idiomatic: " Secretary-in-Chief of the Palace Library Wang Jian submitted the Seven Records he had compiled, thirty volumes in all.

sentences.zh: 京師旱。

translations.literal: The capital region suffered drought.
translations.idiomatic: The capital region suffered drought.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，詔曰：「比亢序騫度，留熏燿晷，有傷秋稼，方貽民瘼。

translations.literal: On jiayin day an edict said: "Recently the drought star has crossed its allotted degree and lingering heat burns the days; autumn crops are harmed and the people's distress is at hand.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day an edict declared: "Recently the drought star has crossed its allotted degree and lingering heat scorches the days; autumn crops are harmed and the people's distress is at hand.

sentences.zh: 朕以眇疚，未弘政道，囹圄尚繁，枉滯猶積，夕厲晨矜，每惻于懷。

translations.literal: I, slight and ailing in conscience, have not yet expanded the path of governance; prisons remain crowded and wrongful detentions still accumulate; evening admonishment and morning compassion weigh on my heart.
translations.idiomatic: I, slight in stature and troubled in conscience, have not yet expanded the path of governance; prisons remain crowded and wrongful detentions still accumulate; evening admonishment and morning compassion weigh on my heart.

sentences.zh: 尚書令可與執法以下，就訊眾獄，使寃訟洗遂，困弊昭蘇。

translations.literal: The Director of the Masters of Writing together with judicial officials downward should go in person to examine the various prisons, so that wrongful lawsuits are cleared and the exhausted revived.
translations.idiomatic: The director of the Masters of Writing together with judicial officials downward should go in person to examine the various prisons, so that wrongful lawsuits are cleared and the exhausted revived.

sentences.zh: 頒下州郡，咸令無壅。

translations.literal: Let this be sent down to the provinces and commanderies; all are to ensure no obstruction.
translations.idiomatic: Let this be sent down to the provinces and commanderies; all are to ensure that nothing is obstructed.

sentences.zh: 」癸亥，鎮軍將軍、南徐州刺史建平王景素進號鎮北將軍。

translations.literal: " On guihai day General Who Tranquilizes the Army and Inspector of South Xuzhou Prince of Jianping Jing-su was advanced in rank to General Who Tranquilizes the North.
translations.idiomatic: " On guihai day General Who Tranquilizes the Army and inspector of South Xuzhou Prince of Jianping Jingsu was promoted to general who tranquilizes the north.

sentences.zh: 庚午，陳留王曹銑薨。

translations.literal: On gengwu day Prince of Chenliu Cao Xuan died.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day Cao Xuan, Prince of Chenliu, died.

sentences.zh: 九月壬午，詔曰：「國賦氓稅，蓋有恒品，往屬戎難，務先軍實，徵課之宜，或乖昔准。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on renwu day, an edict said: "State levies and commoners' taxes have fixed standards; in recent times, owing to military hardship, military supplies came first and the proper measures for collection sometimes departed from former norms.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day in the ninth month an edict declared: "State levies and commoners' taxes have fixed standards; in recent times, owing to military hardship, military supplies came first and the proper measures for collection sometimes departed from former norms.

sentences.zh: 湘、江二州，糧運偏積，調役既繁，庶徒彌擾。

translations.literal: In the two provinces of Xiang and Jiang grain transport piled up unevenly; corvée and levies were already heavy, and the common people were ever more disturbed.
translations.idiomatic: In Xiang and Jiang provinces grain transport piled up unevenly; corvée and levies were already heavy, and the common people were ever more disturbed.

sentences.zh: 因循權政，容有未革，民單力弊，歲月愈甚。

translations.literal: Following expedient policies, some abuses may not yet have been reformed; the people grow ever weaker and the hardship worsens month by month.
translations.idiomatic: Following expedient policies, some abuses may not yet have been reformed; the people grow ever weaker and hardship worsens month by month.

sentences.zh: 永言矜歎，情兼宵寐。

translations.literal: Long do I sigh in compassion, my feelings mingling with sleepless nights.
translations.idiomatic: Long do I sigh in compassion, my feelings mingling with nights without sleep.

sentences.zh: 可遣使到所，明加詳察。

translations.literal: Let envoys be dispatched to the places concerned to examine matters clearly in detail.
translations.idiomatic: Let envoys be sent to each locality to examine matters clearly and in detail.

sentences.zh: 其輸違舊令，役非公限者，並即蠲改，具條以聞。

translations.literal: Whatever deliveries violate old regulations or corvée falls outside public limits, let all be immediately remitted and corrected, with detailed lists reported."
translations.idiomatic: Whatever deliveries violate former regulations or corvée falls outside public limits, let all be remitted and revised at once, with itemized reports submitted."

sentences.zh: 」丁亥，立衡陽王嶷子伯玉為南平王。

translations.literal: On dinghai day the son of Prince of Hengyang Yi, Boyu, was installed as Prince of Nanping.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day Boyu, son of Prince of Hengyang Yi, was installed as Prince of Nanping.

sentences.zh: 冬十月壬子，以撫軍司馬王玄載為梁、南秦二州刺史。

translations.literal: On renzi day in the tenth month of winter Chief Clerk of the Army Who Tranquilizes the Army Wang Xuan-zai was made Inspector of Liang and South Qin provinces.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day in the tenth month of winter Chief Clerk of the Army Who Tranquilizes the Army Wang Xuanzai was appointed inspector of Liang and South Qin provinces.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，割南兗州之鍾離、豫州之馬頭，又分秦郡、梁郡、歷陽置新昌郡，立徐州。

translations.literal: On guiyou day Zhongli of South Yanzhou and Matou of Yuzhou were cut off, and Qin, Liang, and Liyang commanderies were separated to establish Xinchang commandery and create Xuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day Zhongli of South Yanzhou and Matou of Yuzhou were transferred, and Qin, Liang, and Liyang commanderies were separated to establish Xinchang commandery and create Xuzhou.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙子，以散騎常侍垣閎為徐州刺史。

translations.literal: On bingzi day Attendant-in-Ordinary Yuan Hong was made Inspector of Xuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day Attendant-in-Ordinary Yuan Hong was appointed inspector of Xuzhou.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，尚書令袁粲母喪去職。

translations.literal: On dingchou day Director of the Masters of Writing Yuan Can left office due to his mother's mourning.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day Director of the Masters of Writing Yuan Can left office to observe mourning for his mother.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸卯朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: On the first day of the twelfth month, guimao day, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day, the first day of the twelfth month, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，司空、江州刺史桂陽王休範進位太尉，尚書令袁粲還攝本任，加號衞將軍。

translations.literal: On yisi day Minister of Works and Inspector of Jiangzhou Prince of Guiyang Xiu-fan was advanced to Grand Commandant; Director of the Masters of Writing Yuan Can returned to hold his former post in an acting capacity and was given the additional title General of the Guard.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day Minister of Works and inspector of Jiangzhou Prince of Guiyang Xiufan was promoted to grand commandant; Director of the Masters of Writing Yuan Can returned to hold his former post in an acting capacity and was given the additional title general of the guard.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，立前建安王世子伯融為始安縣王。

translations.literal: On guihai day Boyu, former heir of Prince of Jian'an, was installed as Prince of Shi'an county.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day Boyu, former heir of Prince of Jian'an, was installed as prince of Shi'an county.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，河南王遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: On bingyin day the King of Henan sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day the King of Henan sent envoys bearing tribute.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月庚子，以右光祿大夫張永為征北將軍、南兗州刺史。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring in the second year, on gengzi day, Right Grandee for Splendid Virtue Zhang Yong was made General Who Campaigns North and Inspector of South Yanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day in the first month of spring in the second year Right Grandee for Splendid Virtue Zhang Yong was made general who campaigns north and inspector of South Yanzhou.

sentences.zh: 二月己巳，加護軍將軍褚淵中軍將軍。

translations.literal: In the second month, on jisi day, General of the Guard Chu Yuan was given the additional rank of General of the Central Army.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day in the second month General of the Guard Chu Yuan was also made general of the central army.

sentences.zh: 三月癸酉，以左衞將軍王寬為南豫州刺史。

translations.literal: In the third month, on guiyou day, General of the Left Guard Wang Kuan was made Inspector of South Yuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day in the third month General of the Left Guard Wang Kuan was appointed inspector of South Yuzhou.

sentences.zh: 夏四月癸亥，詔曰：「頃列爵敍勳，銓榮酬義，條流積廣，又各淹闕。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on guihai day, an edict said: "Recently, when ranks and fiefs were conferred and merit was recorded, the categories piled up ever wider and each case remained long unsettled.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day in the fourth month of summer an edict declared: "Recently, when ranks and fiefs were conferred and merit was recorded, the categories piled up ever wider and each case remained long unsettled.

sentences.zh: 歲往事留，理至逋壅，在所參差，多違甄飭。

translations.literal: Years pass while matters linger; reason itself comes to obstruction and delay; locally the treatment is uneven and in many cases the proper scrutiny is violated.
translations.idiomatic: Years pass while matters linger; reason itself comes to obstruction and delay; locally the treatment is uneven and in many cases proper scrutiny is violated.

sentences.zh: 賞未均洽，每疚厥心。

translations.literal: Rewards are not evenly distributed, and this weighs on my heart in guilt.
translations.idiomatic: Rewards are not evenly distributed, and this fills my heart with guilt.

sentences.zh: 可悉依舊准，並下注職。」

translations.literal: Let all be handled according to the old standards and reported to the responsible offices."
translations.idiomatic: Let everything be handled according to former standards and reported to the responsible offices."

sentences.zh: 五月壬午，[3]太尉、江州刺史桂陽王休範舉兵反。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on renwu day, [3] Editorial note three stands in the received text at this point in the narrative, Grand Commandant and Inspector of Jiangzhou Prince of Guiyang Xiufan raised troops in rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day in the fifth month, [3] Editorial note three stands in the received text at this point in the narrative, Grand Commandant and inspector of Jiangzhou Prince of Guiyang Xiufan rose in rebellion.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，內外戒嚴。

translations.literal: On gengyin day martial law was proclaimed inside and outside the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day martial law was proclaimed inside and outside the capital.

sentences.zh: 加中領軍劉勔鎮軍將軍，加右衞將軍齊王平南將軍，前鋒南討，出屯新亭。

translations.literal: Central Army Commander Liu Xu was given the additional rank of General Who Tranquilizes the Army; General of the Right Guard Prince of Qi was given the additional rank of General Who Pacifies the South; as vanguard they marched south to attack and encamped at Xinting.
translations.idiomatic: Central army commander Liu Xu was also made general who tranquilizes the army; General of the Right Guard Prince of Qi was also made general who pacifies the south; as vanguard they marched south to attack and encamped at Xinting.

sentences.zh: 征北將軍張永屯白下，前南兗州刺史沈懷明戍石頭，衞將軍袁粲、中軍將軍褚淵入衞殿省。

translations.literal: General Who Campaigns North Zhang Yong encamped at Baixia; former Inspector of South Yanzhou Shen Huai-ming garrisoned Shitou; General of the Guard Yuan Can and General of the Central Army Chu Yuan entered to guard the palace offices.
translations.idiomatic: General Who Campaigns North Zhang Yong encamped at Baixia; former inspector of South Yanzhou Shen Huaiming garrisoned Shitou; General of the Guard Yuan Can and General of the Central Army Chu Yuan entered to guard the palace offices.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，賊奄至，攻新亭壘。

translations.literal: On renchen day the rebels suddenly arrived and attacked the fortress at Xinting.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day the rebels suddenly arrived and assaulted the fortress at Xinting.

sentences.zh: 齊王拒擊，大破之。

translations.literal: Prince of Qi repelled the attack and inflicted a great defeat on them.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Qi repelled them and routed them utterly.

sentences.zh: 越騎校尉張敬兒斬休範。

translations.literal: Commandant of Overcoming Cavalry Zhang Jing-er beheaded Xiufan.
translations.idiomatic: Commandant of Overcoming Cavalry Zhang Jing'er beheaded Xiufan.

sentences.zh: 賊黨杜黑蠡、丁文豪分軍向朱雀航，[4]劉勔拒賊敗績，力戰死之。

translations.literal: Rebel partisans Du Hei-li and Ding Wen-hao divided their forces toward the Zhuque floating bridge; [4] Editorial note four stands in the received text at this point in the narrative, Liu Xu resisted the rebels but suffered defeat and died fighting to the last.
translations.idiomatic: Rebel followers Du Heili and Ding Wenhao split their forces toward the Zhuque floating bridge; [4] Editorial note four stands in the received text at this point in the narrative, Liu Xu resisted the rebels but was defeated and died in battle.

sentences.zh: 右軍將軍王道隆奔走遇害。

translations.literal: General of the Right Army Wang Dao-long fled in flight and met with death.
translations.idiomatic: General of the Right Army Wang Daolong fled and was killed.

sentences.zh: 張永潰於白下，沈懷明自石頭奔散。

translations.literal: Zhang Yong was routed at Baixia; Shen Huai-ming fled and scattered from Shitou.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Yong was routed at Baixia; Shen Huaiming fled in disarray from Shitou.

sentences.zh: 甲午，[5]撫軍典籤茅恬開東府納賊，[6]賊入屯中堂。

translations.literal: On jiawu day, [5] Editorial note five stands in the received text at this point in the narrative, Registry Clerk of the Army Who Tranquilizes the Army Mao Tian opened the Eastern Office to admit the rebels; [6] Editorial note six stands in the received text at this point in the narrative, the rebels entered and encamped at the Central Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day, [5] Editorial note five stands in the received text at this point in the narrative, registry clerk of the Army Who Tranquilizes the Army Mao Tian opened the Eastern Office to admit the rebels; [6] Editorial note six stands in the received text at this point in the narrative, the rebels entered and encamped in the Central Hall.

sentences.zh: 羽林監陳顯達擊大破之。

translations.literal: Director of the Feathered Forest Guard Chen Xian-da attacked and inflicted a great defeat on them.
translations.idiomatic: Director of the Feathered Forest Guard Chen Xianda attacked and routed them.

sentences.zh: 丙申，張敬兒等破賊於宣陽門、莊嚴寺、小市，進平東府城，梟擒羣賊。

translations.literal: On bingshen day Zhang Jing-er and others defeated the rebels at Xuanyang Gate, Zhuangyan Temple, and Xiaoshi Market, advanced to pacify the Eastern Office city, and beheaded and captured the rebel band.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day Zhang Jing'er and others defeated the rebels at Xuanyang Gate, Zhuangyan Temple, and Xiaoshi market, then advanced to pacify the Eastern Office and captured and executed the rebel band.

sentences.zh: 賞賜封爵各有差。

translations.literal: Rewards, gifts, and enfeoffments were granted with varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Rewards, gifts, and enfeoffments were granted according to merit.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，詔京邑二縣埋藏所殺賊，并戰亡者，復同京城。

translations.literal: On dingyou day an edict ordered the two counties of the capital region to bury the slain rebels and also those who died in battle, with the same arrangements as in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day an edict ordered the two counties of the capital region to bury the slain rebels and those who died in battle, with burial arrangements the same as in the capital.

sentences.zh: 是日解嚴，大赦天下，文武賜位一等。

translations.literal: That same day martial law was lifted, a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm, and civil and military officials were granted one rank higher.
translations.idiomatic: That same day martial law was lifted, a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm, and civil and military officials received one rank promotion.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，原除江州逋債，其有課非常調、役為民蠹者，悉皆蠲停。

translations.literal: On wuxu day arrears of debt in Jiangzhou were remitted; whatever extraordinary levies or corvée that were vermin to the people were all remitted and halted.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day Jiangzhou's outstanding debts were remitted; any extraordinary levies or corvée that plagued the people were all cancelled.

sentences.zh: 詔曰：「頃國賦多騫，公儲罕給。

translations.literal: An edict said: "Recently state levies have fallen short in many cases and public stores rarely suffice.
translations.idiomatic: An edict declared: "Recently state revenues have fallen short in many areas and public stores rarely suffice.

sentences.zh: 近治戎雖淺，而軍費已多，廩藏虛罄，難用馭遠。

translations.literal: Though recent military campaigns have been shallow, military expenses are already heavy; granaries and treasuries stand empty and exhausted, making it hard to govern distant regions.
translations.idiomatic: Though recent campaigns have been brief, military expenses are already heavy; granaries and treasuries stand empty, making distant governance difficult.

sentences.zh: 宜矯革淫長，務在節儉。

translations.literal: It is fitting to correct excessive growth and devote effort to frugality.
translations.idiomatic: It is fitting to curb excessive spending and devote effort to frugality.

sentences.zh: 其供奉服御，悉就減撤，雕文靡麗，廢而勿修。

translations.literal: Offerings for service and imperial use should all be reduced and withdrawn; ornate carved decoration should be abandoned and not restored.
translations.idiomatic: Palace offerings and imperial accoutrements should all be reduced; ornate carved decoration should be abandoned and not restored.

sentences.zh: 凡諸游費，一皆禁斷，外可詳為科格。

translations.literal: All various pleasure expenditures are entirely forbidden; outside the palace detailed regulations may be drawn up.
translations.idiomatic: All pleasure expenditures are entirely forbidden; detailed regulations may be drawn up for enforcement.

sentences.zh: 」荊州刺史沈攸之、南徐州刺史建平王景素、郢州刺史晉熙王燮、湘州刺史王僧虔、雍州刺史張興世並舉義兵赴京師。

translations.literal: Inspector of Jingzhou Shen You-zhi, Inspector of South Xuzhou Prince of Jianping Jing-su, Inspector of Yingzhou Prince of Jinxi Xie, Inspector of Xiangzhou Wang Seng-qian, and Inspector of Yongzhou Zhang Xing-shi all raised righteous armies and marched to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Inspector of Jingzhou Shen Youzhi, inspector of South Xuzhou Prince of Jianping Jingsu, inspector of Yingzhou Prince of Jinxi Xie, inspector of Xiangzhou Wang Sengqian, and inspector of Yongzhou Zhang Xingshi all raised righteous armies and marched to the capital.

sentences.zh: 己亥，以第七皇弟友為江州刺史。

translations.literal: On jihai day the seventh imperial younger brother You was made Inspector of Jiangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day the seventh imperial younger brother You was appointed inspector of Jiangzhou.

sentences.zh: 芮芮國遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: The state of Rouran sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: The state of Rouran sent envoys bearing tribute.

sentences.zh: 六月庚子，以平南將軍齊王為中領軍、鎮軍將軍、南兗州刺史。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on gengzi day, Prince of Qi, General Who Pacifies the South, was made Central Army Commander, General Who Tranquilizes the Army, and Inspector of South Yanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day in the sixth month Prince of Qi, general who pacifies the south, was made central army commander, general who tranquilizes the army, and inspector of South Yanzhou.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，晉熙王燮遣軍剋尋陽，江州平。

translations.literal: On guimao day Prince of Jinxi Xie dispatched troops to capture Xunyang, and Jiangzhou was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day Prince of Jinxi Xie dispatched troops to capture Xunyang and Jiangzhou was pacified.

sentences.zh: 戊申，以淮南太守任農夫為豫州刺史，右將軍、南豫州刺史王寬進號平西將軍。

translations.literal: On wushen day Administrator of Huainan Ren Nong-fu was made Inspector of Yuzhou; General of the Right and Inspector of South Yuzhou Wang Kuan was advanced in rank to General Who Pacifies the West.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day administrator of Huainan Ren Nongfu was appointed inspector of Yuzhou; General of the Right and inspector of South Yuzhou Wang Kuan was promoted to general who pacifies the west.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，改輔師將軍還為輔國。

translations.literal: On renxu day the title General Who Assists the Army was changed back to General Who Assists the State.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day the title general who assists the army was restored to general who assists the state.

sentences.zh: 秋七月庚辰，立第七皇弟友為邵陵王。

translations.literal: On gengchen day in the seventh month of autumn the seventh imperial younger brother You was installed as Prince of Shaoling.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day in the seventh month of autumn the seventh imperial younger brother You was installed as Prince of Shaoling.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，以撫軍司馬孟次陽為兗州刺史。

translations.literal: On xinsi day Chief Clerk of the Army Who Tranquilizes the Army Meng Ci-yang was made Inspector of Yanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day chief clerk of the Army Who Tranquilizes the Army Meng Ciyang was appointed inspector of Yanzhou.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，鎮西將軍、荊州刺史沈攸之進號征西大將軍，鎮北將軍、南徐州刺史建平王景素進號征北將軍，[7]並開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: On yiyou day General Who Tranquilizes the West and Inspector of Jingzhou Shen You-zhi was advanced in rank to Grand General Who Campaigns West; General Who Tranquilizes the North and Inspector of South Xuzhou Prince of Jianping Jing-su was advanced in rank to General Who Campaigns North; [7] Editorial note seven stands in the received text at this point in the narrative, both were granted the Bearer of the Staff with Equal Protocol to the Three Ducal Ministers.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day General Who Tranquilizes the West and inspector of Jingzhou Shen Youzhi was promoted to grand general who campaigns west; General Who Tranquilizes the North and inspector of South Xuzhou Prince of Jianping Jingsu was promoted to general who campaigns north; [7] Editorial note seven stands in the received text at this point in the narrative, both were granted bearer of the staff with equal protocol to the Three Ducal Ministers.

sentences.zh: 征虜將軍、郢州刺史晉熙王燮進號安西將軍，前將軍、湘州刺史王僧虔進號平南將軍。

translations.literal: General Who Campaigns against Barbarians and Inspector of Yingzhou Prince of Jinxi Xie was advanced in rank to General Who Pacifies the West; Former General and Inspector of Xiangzhou Wang Seng-qian was advanced in rank to General Who Pacifies the South.
translations.idiomatic: General who campaigns against barbarians and inspector of Yingzhou Prince of Jinxi Xie was promoted to general who pacifies the west; former general and inspector of Xiangzhou Wang Sengqian was promoted to general who pacifies the south.

sentences.zh: 八月辛酉，以征虜行參軍劉延祖為寧州刺史。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on xinyou day, Acting Staff Officer of the Army Who Campaigns against Barbarians Liu Yan-zu was made Inspector of Ningzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day in the eighth month acting staff officer of the army who campaigns against barbarians Liu Yanzu was appointed inspector of Ningzhou.

sentences.zh: 九月壬辰，以游擊將軍呂安國為兗州刺史。

translations.literal: On renchen day in the ninth month General Who Roams and Strikes Lü An-guo was made Inspector of Yanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day in the ninth month General Who Roams and Strikes Lü Anguo was appointed inspector of Yanzhou.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，以尚書令、新除衞將軍袁粲為中書監，即本號開府儀同三司，領司徒，加護軍將軍褚淵尚書令，撫軍將軍、揚州刺史安成王進號車騎將軍。

translations.literal: On dingyou day Director of the Masters of Writing and newly appointed General of the Guard Yuan Can was made Supervisor of the Secretariat, retaining his title with Bearer of the Staff with Equal Protocol to the Three Ducal Ministers and heading the Minister of Ceremonies; General of the Guard Chu Yuan was given the additional rank of Director of the Masters of Writing; and General Who Tranquilizes the Army and Inspector of Yangzhou Prince of Ancheng was advanced in rank to General of Chariots and Cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day Director of the Masters of Writing and newly appointed general of the guard Yuan Can was made supervisor of the secretariat, retaining his title with bearer of the staff with equal protocol to the Three Ducal Ministers and heading the minister of ceremonies; General of the Guard Chu Yuan was also made director of the Masters of Writing; and General Who Tranquilizes the Army and inspector of Yangzhou Prince of Ancheng was promoted to general of chariots and cavalry.

sentences.zh: 冬十月庚申，以新除侍中王蘊為湘州刺史。

translations.literal: On gengshen day in the tenth month of winter the newly appointed Attendant-in-Ordinary Wang Yun was made Inspector of Xiangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day in the tenth month of winter newly appointed attendant-in-ordinary Wang Yun was appointed inspector of Xiangzhou.

sentences.zh: 甲子，以游擊將軍陳顯達為廣州刺史。

translations.literal: On jiazi day General Who Roams and Strikes Chen Xian-da was made Inspector of Guangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day General Who Roams and Strikes Chen Xianda was appointed inspector of Guangzhou.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙戌，御加元服，大赦天下。

translations.literal: On bingxu day in the eleventh month the emperor performed the capping ceremony and proclaimed a general amnesty throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day in the eleventh month the emperor came of age and proclaimed a general amnesty throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 賜民男子爵一級；

translations.literal: Common men were granted one rank of nobility;
translations.idiomatic: Common men were granted one rank of nobility;

sentences.zh: 為父後及三老孝悌力田者爵二級；

translations.literal: those who were heirs to their fathers and the village elders of filial piety, brotherly love, and diligent farming received two ranks;
translations.idiomatic: heirs to their fathers and the village elders honored for filial piety, brotherly love, and diligent farming received two ranks;

sentences.zh: 鰥寡孤獨篤癃不能自存者，穀人五斛；

translations.literal: widowers, widows, orphans, the solitary, the seriously ill and disabled unable to support themselves received five hu of grain per person;
translations.idiomatic: widowers, widows, orphans, the solitary, and the seriously ill and disabled who could not support themselves received five hu of grain each;

sentences.zh: [8]年八十以上，加帛一匹。

translations.literal: [8] Editorial note eight stands in the received text at this point in the narrative. Those eighty years of age and above received an additional bolt of cloth.
translations.idiomatic: [8] Editorial note eight stands in the received text at this point in the narrative. Those eighty years of age and above received an additional bolt of cloth.

sentences.zh: 大酺五日；

translations.literal: Great communal feasting for five days;
translations.idiomatic: Great communal feasting lasted five days.

sentences.zh: 賜王公以下各有差。

translations.literal: princes, dukes, and those below were rewarded with varying gifts.
translations.idiomatic: princes, dukes, and officials below them received gifts according to rank.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸亥，立第八皇弟躋為江夏王，第九皇弟贊為武陵王。

translations.literal: On guihai day in the twelfth month the eighth imperial younger brother Ji was installed as Prince of Jiangxia, and the ninth imperial younger brother Zan was installed as Prince of Wuling.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day in the twelfth month the eighth imperial younger brother Ji was installed as Prince of Jiangxia and the ninth imperial younger brother Zan as Prince of Wuling.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月辛巳，車駕親祠南郊、明堂。

translations.literal: On xinsi day in the first month of spring in the third year the imperial carriage personally performed sacrifice at the Southern Suburbs and the Bright Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day in the first month of spring in the third year the emperor personally sacrificed at the Southern Suburbs and the Bright Hall.

sentences.zh: 三月丙寅，河南王遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: In the third month, on bingyin day, the King of Henan sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day in the third month the King of Henan sent envoys bearing tribute.

sentences.zh: 己巳，以車騎將軍張敬兒為雍州刺史。

translations.literal: On jisi day General of Chariots and Cavalry Zhang Jing-er was made Inspector of Yongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day General of Chariots and Cavalry Zhang Jing'er was appointed inspector of Yongzhou.

sentences.zh: 其日，京師大水，遣尚書郎官長檢行賑賜。

translations.literal: That same day the capital region suffered great flooding; Masters of Writing officials were dispatched to inspect and grant relief.
translations.idiomatic: That same day the capital region suffered severe flooding, and Masters of Writing officials were dispatched to inspect the damage and grant relief.

sentences.zh: 閏月戊戌，詔曰：「頃民俗滋弊，國度未殷，歲時屢騫，編戶不給。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month, on wuxu day, an edict said: "Recently popular customs grow ever debased, state resources are not abundant, year after year revenues fall short, and registered households cannot meet their obligations.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day in the intercalary month an edict declared: "Recently popular customs grow ever debased, state resources are not abundant, year after year revenues fall short, and registered households cannot meet their obligations.

sentences.zh: 且邊虞尚警，徭費彌繁，永言夕惕，寢興增疚。

translations.literal: Moreover border alarms still warn, corvée and expenses grow ever heavier; long do I speak of evening vigilance, and rising and sleeping add to my guilt.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover border alarms still warn and corvée and expenses grow ever heavier; long do I speak of evening vigilance, and waking and sleeping add to my guilt.

sentences.zh: 思弘豐耗之制，以惇約素之風，庶偫蓄拯民，以康治道。

translations.literal: I think to expand the system of abundance and economy and encourage simple and plain customs, so that stored reserves may save the people and the path of governance be secured.
translations.idiomatic: I wish to expand the system of abundance and economy and encourage simple and plain customs, so that stored reserves may save the people and the path of governance be secured.

sentences.zh: 太官珍膳，御府麗服，諸所供擬，一皆減撤，可詳為其格，務從簡衷。」

translations.literal: Grand kitchen delicacies, palace beautiful garments, and all provisions are to be reduced and withdrawn; detailed standards may be drawn up, striving for simplicity at heart."
translations.idiomatic: Palace kitchen delicacies, imperial wardrobe finery, and all provisions are to be reduced; detailed standards may be drawn up, striving for simplicity at heart."

sentences.zh: 夏四月，遣尚書郎到諸州檢括民戶，窮老尤貧者，蠲除課調；

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer Masters of Writing officials were dispatched to the provinces to examine registered households; the extremely poor and aged had levies remitted;
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer Masters of Writing officials were sent to the provinces to examine registered households; the extremely poor and aged had their levies remitted;

sentences.zh: 丁壯猶有生業，隨宜寬申；

translations.literal: able-bodied men who still had livelihoods received appropriate leniency and extension;
translations.idiomatic: able-bodied men who still had livelihoods received appropriate leniency and extensions;

sentences.zh: 貲財足以充限者，督令洗畢。

translations.literal: those whose assets sufficed to meet quotas were urged to complete payment.
translations.idiomatic: those whose assets sufficed to meet quotas were urged to settle their obligations.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，車駕幸中堂聽訟。

translations.literal: On bingxu day the imperial carriage visited the Central Hall to hear lawsuits.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day the emperor visited the Central Hall to hear lawsuits.

sentences.zh: 六月癸未，北國使至。

translations.literal: On guiwei day in the sixth month envoys from the Northern State arrived.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day in the sixth month envoys from the Northern State arrived.

sentences.zh: 兼司徒袁粲、尚書令褚淵並固讓。

translations.literal: Acting Minister of Ceremonies Yuan Can and Director of the Masters of Writing Chu Yuan both firmly declined.
translations.idiomatic: Acting minister of ceremonies Yuan Can and Director of the Masters of Writing Chu Yuan both firmly declined their appointments.

sentences.zh: 秋七月庚戌，以粲為尚書令。

translations.literal: On gengxu day in the seventh month of autumn Yuan Can was made Director of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day in the seventh month of autumn Yuan Can was appointed director of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，以給事黃門侍郎劉懷珍為豫州刺史。

translations.literal: On renxu day Attendant Gentleman of the Yellow Gate Liu Huai-zhen was made Inspector of Yuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day attendant gentleman of the yellow gate Liu Huaizhen was appointed inspector of Yuzhou.

sentences.zh: 八月庚子，[9]加護軍將軍褚淵中書監。

translations.literal: On gengzi day in the eighth month, [9] Editorial note nine stands in the received text at this point in the narrative, General of the Guard Chu Yuan was given the additional rank of Supervisor of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day in the eighth month, [9] Editorial note nine stands in the received text at this point in the narrative, General of the Guard Chu Yuan was also made supervisor of the secretariat.

sentences.zh: 九月丙辰，征西大將軍河南王吐谷渾拾夤進號車騎大將軍。

translations.literal: On bingchen day in the ninth month Grand General Who Campaigns West King of Henan Tuyuhun Shiyin was advanced in rank to Grand General of Chariots and Cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day in the ninth month Grand General Who Campaigns West King of Henan Tuyuhun Shiyin was promoted to grand general of chariots and cavalry.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙戌，高麗國遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: On bingxu day in the tenth month of winter the state of Goguryeo sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day in the tenth month of winter the state of Goguryeo sent envoys bearing tribute.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙丑，以冠軍將軍姚道和為司州刺史。

translations.literal: On yichou day in the twelfth month General Who Overcomes Chuan Yao Dao-he was made Inspector of Sizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day in the twelfth month General Who Overcomes Chuan Yao Daohe was appointed inspector of Sizhou.

sentences.zh: 四年春正月已亥，車駕躬耕籍田，大赦天下。

translations.literal: On jihai day in the first month of spring in the fourth year the imperial carriage personally plowed the sacred field and proclaimed a general amnesty throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day in the first month of spring in the fourth year the emperor personally plowed the sacred field and proclaimed a general amnesty throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 賜力田爵一級；

translations.literal: Diligent farmers were granted one rank of nobility;
translations.idiomatic: Diligent farmers were granted one rank of nobility;

sentences.zh: 貸貧民糧種。

translations.literal: the poor were lent grain seeds.
translations.idiomatic: the poor were lent grain seed.

sentences.zh: 壬子，以梁、南秦二州刺史王玄載為益州刺史。

translations.literal: On renzi day Inspector of Liang and South Qin provinces Wang Xuan-zai was made Inspector of Yizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day inspector of Liang and South Qin provinces Wang Xuanzai was appointed inspector of Yizhou.

sentences.zh: 二月壬戌，以步兵校尉范栢年為梁、南秦二州刺史。

translations.literal: In the second month, on renxu day, Commandant of Foot Soldiers Fan Bai-nian was made Inspector of Liang and South Qin provinces.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day in the second month Commandant of Foot Soldiers Fan Bainian was appointed inspector of Liang and South Qin provinces.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，加金紫光祿大夫王琨特進。

translations.literal: On dingmao day Grandee for Golden-purple Splendor Wang Kun was given special advancement.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day Grandee for Golden-purple Splendor Wang Kun was granted special advancement.

sentences.zh: 夏五月，以寧朔將軍武都王楊文度為北秦州刺史。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of summer General Who Pacifies the North Yang Wen-du, King of Wudu, was made Inspector of North Qinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of summer General Who Pacifies the North Yang Wendu, King of Wudu, was appointed inspector of North Qinzhou.

sentences.zh: 乙未，尚書右丞虞玩之表陳時事曰：

translations.literal: On yimao day Vice-Director of the Right of the Masters of Writing Yu Wan-zhi submitted a memorial on current affairs, saying:
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day vice-director of the right of the Masters of Writing Yu Wanzhi submitted a memorial on current affairs, saying:

sentences.zh: 天府虛散，垂三十年。

translations.literal: The heavenly treasury has stood empty and dispersed for nearly thirty years.
translations.idiomatic: The imperial treasury has stood empty and dispersed for nearly thirty years.

sentences.zh: 江、荊諸州，稅調本少，自頃以來，軍募多乏。

translations.literal: The Jiang and Jing provinces originally had few taxes and levies; since recent times military recruitment has often lacked funds.
translations.idiomatic: Jiang and Jing provinces originally had few taxes and levies; in recent times military recruitment has often lacked funds.

sentences.zh: 其穀帛所入，折供文武。

translations.literal: The grain and silk revenues were entirely diverted to supply civil and military officials.
translations.idiomatic: Grain and silk revenues were entirely diverted to supply civil and military officials.

sentences.zh: 豫、兗、司、徐，開口待哺，西北戎將，裸身求衣。

translations.literal: In Yuzhou, Yanzhou, Sizhou, and Xuzhou mouths opened awaiting nourishment; in the northwest frontier generals went naked seeking clothes.
translations.idiomatic: In Yuzhou, Yanzhou, Sizhou, and Xuzhou people opened their mouths awaiting nourishment; on the northwest frontier generals went naked seeking clothes.

sentences.zh: 委輸京都，蓋為寡薄。

translations.literal: What was sent in tribute to the capital was paltry indeed.
translations.idiomatic: What was sent in tribute to the capital was meager indeed.

sentences.zh: 天府所資，唯有淮、海。

translations.literal: What the heavenly treasury relied upon was solely the Huai and the sea regions.
translations.idiomatic: What the imperial treasury relied upon was solely the Huai and sea regions.

sentences.zh: 民荒財單，不及曩日。

translations.literal: The people are impoverished and resources thin, not reaching former days.
translations.idiomatic: The people are impoverished and resources thin, falling short of former days.

sentences.zh: 而國度弘費，[10]四倍元嘉。

translations.literal: Yet state expenditures are vast, [10] Editorial note ten stands in the received text at this point in the narrative, four times those of the Yuanjia era.
translations.idiomatic: Yet state expenditures are vast, [10] Editorial note ten stands in the received text at this point in the narrative, four times those of the Yuanjia era.

sentences.zh: 二衞臺坊人力，五不餘一；

translations.literal: Manpower of the Two Guards and platform offices: not one in five remained;
translations.idiomatic: Manpower of the Two Guards and platform offices: not one in five remained;

sentences.zh: 都水材官朽散，十不兩存。

translations.literal: timber officials of the capital waterworks were rotten and scattered; not two in ten survived.
translations.idiomatic: timber officials of the capital waterworks were rotten and scattered; not two in ten survived.

sentences.zh: 備豫都庫，材竹俱盡；

translations.literal: Reserve capital storehouses had timber and bamboo entirely exhausted;
translations.idiomatic: Reserve capital storehouses had timber and bamboo entirely exhausted;

sentences.zh: 東西二𡍒，塼瓦雙匱。

translations.literal: the east and west twin kilns had bricks and tiles doubly depleted.
translations.idiomatic: the east and west twin kilns had bricks and tiles doubly depleted.

sentences.zh: 敕令給賜，悉仰交市。

translations.literal: Imperial orders for grants all depended on market purchases.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial orders for grants all depended on market purchases.

sentences.zh: 尚書省舍，日就傾頹，第宅府署，類多穿毀。

translations.literal: Masters of Writing offices daily crumbled; mansions and government offices were mostly riddled with holes and ruin.
translations.idiomatic: Masters of Writing offices crumbled day by day; mansions and government offices were mostly riddled with holes and ruin.

sentences.zh: 視不遑救，知不暇及。

translations.literal: To see and have no time to repair; to know and have no leisure to reach it.
translations.idiomatic: To see and have no time to repair; to know and have no leisure to act.

sentences.zh: 尋所入定調，用恒不周，既無儲畜，理至空盡。

translations.literal: Investigating the fixed annual levies, expenditures constantly fell short; with no reserves, reason itself led to total emptiness.
translations.idiomatic: Investigating the fixed annual levies, expenditures constantly fell short; with no reserves, the treasury was inevitably emptied.

sentences.zh: 積弊累耗，鍾於今日。

translations.literal: Accumulated abuses and repeated waste have culminated today.
translations.idiomatic: Accumulated abuses and repeated waste have culminated today.

sentences.zh: 昔歲奉敕，課以揚、徐眾逋，凡入米穀六十萬斛，錢五千餘萬，布絹五萬匹，雜物在外，賴此相贍，故得推移。

translations.literal: Last year by imperial order arrears were levied from the masses of Yang and Xu; in all there entered six hundred thousand hu of grain, more than fifty million in cash, fifty thousand bolts of silk and cloth, and miscellaneous goods besides; relying on this to sustain affairs, the state was thus able to carry on.
translations.idiomatic: Last year by imperial order arrears were levied from the masses of Yang and Xu; in all there entered six hundred thousand hu of grain, more than fifty million in cash, fifty thousand bolts of silk and cloth, and miscellaneous goods besides; relying on this to sustain affairs, the state was thus able to carry on.

sentences.zh: 即今所懸轉多，興用漸廣，深懼供奉頓闕，軍器輟功，將士飢怨，百官騫祿。

translations.literal: Now outstanding debts grow ever greater and expenditures expand; I deeply fear that palace supplies will suddenly fail, military implements will halt mid-work, soldiers will hunger and resent, and the hundred officials will see salaries cut.
translations.idiomatic: Now outstanding debts grow ever greater and expenditures expand; I deeply fear that palace supplies will suddenly fail, military production will halt, soldiers will hunger and resent, and officials will see their salaries cut.

sentences.zh: 署府謝雕麗之器，土木停緹紫之容，國戚無以贍，勳求無以給。

translations.literal: Government offices lack ornate vessels; construction halts purple-trimmed splendor; imperial kin cannot be sustained; merit seekers cannot be supplied.
translations.idiomatic: Government offices lack ornate vessels; construction halts purple-trimmed splendor; imperial kin cannot be sustained; those seeking reward cannot be supplied.

sentences.zh: 如愚管所慮，不月則歲矣。

translations.literal: As this foolish office considers the matter, not months but a year remain.
translations.idiomatic: As this foolish office considers the matter, collapse is not months but a year away.

sentences.zh: 經國遠謀，臣所不敢言，朝夕祗勤，心存於匪懈。

translations.literal: Long-term plans for governing the state your servant dares not speak of; morning and evening I am reverently diligent, my heart set on never slackening.
translations.idiomatic: Long-term plans for governing the state your servant dares not speak of; morning and evening I am reverently diligent, my heart set on never slackening.

sentences.zh: 起伏震遽，事屬冒聞。

translations.literal: Rising and falling in trembling haste, the matter belongs to presumptuous reporting.
translations.idiomatic: Rising and falling in trembling haste, the matter belongs to presumptuous reporting.

sentences.zh: 伏願陛下留須臾之鑒，垂永代之計，發不世之詔，施必行之典。

translations.literal: I humbly wish that Your Majesty pause a moment's regard, extend an eternal design, issue an extraordinary edict, and enact a binding statute.
translations.idiomatic: I humbly wish that Your Majesty pause a moment's regard, extend an eternal design, issue an extraordinary edict, and enact a binding statute.

sentences.zh: 則氓隸齊歡，[11]高卑同泰。

translations.literal: Then commoners and slaves alike will rejoice, [11] Editorial note eleven stands in the received text at this point in the narrative, and high and low will share peace.
translations.idiomatic: Then commoners and slaves alike will rejoice, [11] Editorial note eleven stands in the received text at this point in the narrative, and high and low will share peace.

sentences.zh: 帝優詔答之。

translations.literal: The emperor replied with a gracious edict.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor replied with a gracious edict.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，以驍騎將軍曹欣之為徐州刺史。

translations.literal: On gengxu day General of Valiant Cavalry Cao Xin-zhi was made Inspector of Xuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day General of Valiant Cavalry Cao Xinzhi was appointed inspector of Xuzhou.

sentences.zh: 六月乙亥，加鎮軍將軍齊王尚書左僕射。

translations.literal: On yihai day in the sixth month Prince of Qi, General Who Tranquilizes the Army, was given the additional rank of Left Vice-Director of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day in the sixth month Prince of Qi, general who tranquilizes the army, was also made left vice-director of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 八月丁卯，立第十皇弟翽為南陽王，第十一皇弟嵩為新興王，第十二皇弟禧為始建王。

translations.literal: On dingmao day in the eighth month the tenth imperial younger brother Hui was installed as Prince of Nanyang, the eleventh imperial younger brother Song was installed as Prince of Xinxing, and the twelfth imperial younger brother Xi was installed as Prince of Shijian.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day in the eighth month the tenth imperial younger brother Hui was installed as Prince of Nanyang, the eleventh imperial younger brother Song as Prince of Xinxing, and the twelfth imperial younger brother Xi as Prince of Shijian.

sentences.zh: 庚午，以給事黃門侍郎阮佃夫為南豫州刺史。

translations.literal: On gengwu day Attendant Gentleman of the Yellow Gate Ruan Tian-fu was made Inspector of South Yuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day attendant gentleman of the yellow gate Ruan Tianfu was appointed inspector of South Yuzhou.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，以行青、冀二州刺史劉善明為青、冀二州刺史。

translations.literal: On yiyou day Acting Inspector of Qing and Ji provinces Liu Shan-ming was made Inspector of Qing and Ji provinces.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day acting inspector of Qing and Ji provinces Liu Shanming was appointed inspector of Qing and Ji provinces.

sentences.zh: 九月丁亥，割郢州之隨郡屬司州。

translations.literal: On dinghai day in the ninth month Suicheng commandery of Yingzhou was cut off and assigned to Sizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day in the ninth month Suicheng commandery of Yingzhou was transferred to Sizhou.

sentences.zh: 戊子，驍騎將軍高道慶有罪，賜死。

translations.literal: On wuzi day General of Valiant Cavalry Gao Dao-qing, having committed an offense, was granted death.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day General of Valiant Cavalry Gao Daoging, having committed an offense, was sentenced to death.

sentences.zh: 己丑，車騎將軍、揚州刺史安成王進號驃騎大將軍、開府儀同三司，安西將軍、郢州刺史晉熙王燮進號鎮西將軍。

translations.literal: On jichou day General of Chariots and Cavalry and Inspector of Yangzhou Prince of Ancheng was advanced in rank to Grand General of Rapid Cavalry, Bearer of the Staff with Equal Protocol to the Three Ducal Ministers; General Who Pacifies the West and Inspector of Yingzhou Prince of Jinxi Xie was advanced in rank to General Who Tranquilizes the West.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day General of Chariots and Cavalry and inspector of Yangzhou Prince of Ancheng was promoted to grand general of rapid cavalry and granted bearer of the staff with equal protocol to the Three Ducal Ministers; General Who Pacifies the West and inspector of Yingzhou Prince of Jinxi Xie was promoted to general who tranquilizes the west.

sentences.zh: 冬十月辛酉，以吏部尚書王僧虔為尚書右僕射。

translations.literal: On xinyou day in the tenth month of winter Director of the Ministry of Personnel Wang Seng-qian was made Right Vice-Director of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day in the tenth month of winter director of the ministry of personnel Wang Sengqian was appointed right vice-director of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 宕昌王梁彌機為安西將軍、河涼二州刺史。

translations.literal: King of Dangchang Liang Mi-ji was made General Who Pacifies the West and Inspector of He and Liang provinces.
translations.idiomatic: King of Dangchang Liang Miji was appointed general who pacifies the west and inspector of He and Liang provinces.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，中書監、護軍將軍褚淵母憂去職。

translations.literal: On bingyin day Supervisor of the Secretariat and General of the Guard Chu Yuan left office due to his mother's mourning.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day supervisor of the secretariat and General of the Guard Chu Yuan left office to observe mourning for his mother.

sentences.zh: 十一月庚戌，詔攝本任。

translations.literal: On gengxu day in the eleventh month an edict ordered him to hold his former post in an acting capacity.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day in the eleventh month an edict ordered him to resume his former post in an acting capacity.

sentences.zh: 五年春二月壬申，以建寧太守柳和為寧州刺史。

translations.literal: On renshen day in the second month of spring in the fifth year Administrator of Jianning Liu He was made Inspector of Ningzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day in the second month of spring in the fifth year administrator of Jianning Liu He was appointed inspector of Ningzhou.

sentences.zh: 四月甲戌，豫州刺史阮佃夫、步兵校尉申伯宗、朱幼謀廢立，佃夫、幼下獄死，伯宗伏誅。

translations.literal: On jiaxu day in the fourth month Inspector of Yuzhou Ruan Tian-fu, Commandant of Foot Soldiers Shen Bo-zong, and Zhu You plotted deposition and installation; Tian-fu and You died in prison, and Bo-zong was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day in the fourth month inspector of Yuzhou Ruan Tianfu, commandant of foot soldiers Shen Bozong, and Zhu You plotted to depose and replace the emperor; Tianfu and You died in prison, and Bozong was executed.

sentences.zh: 五月己亥，以左軍將軍沈景德為交州刺史，驍騎將軍全景文為南豫州刺史。

translations.literal: On jihai day in the fifth month General of the Left Army Shen Jing-de was made Inspector of Jiaozhou, and General of Valiant Cavalry Quan Jing-wen was made Inspector of South Yuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day in the fifth month General of the Left Army Shen Jingde was appointed inspector of Jiaozhou, and General of Valiant Cavalry Quan Jingwen was appointed inspector of South Yuzhou.

sentences.zh: [12]丙午，以屯騎校尉孫曇瓘為越州刺史。

translations.literal: [12] Editorial note twelve stands in the received text at this point in the narrative. On bingwu day Commandant of Stationary Cavalry Sun Tan-guan was made Inspector of Yuezhou.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day, [12] Editorial note twelve stands in the received text at this point in the narrative, Commandant of Stationary Cavalry Sun Tanguan was appointed inspector of Yuezhou.

sentences.zh: 六月甲戌，誅司徒左長史沈勃、散騎常侍杜幼文、游擊將軍孫超之、長水校尉杜叔文，大赦天下。

translations.literal: On jiaxu day in the sixth month Left Chief Clerk of the Minister of Ceremonies Shen Bo, Attendant-in-Ordinary Du You-wen, General Who Roams and Strikes Sun Chao-zhi, and Commandant of the Long Water Du Shu-wen were executed, and a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day in the sixth month left chief clerk of the minister of ceremonies Shen Bo, attendant-in-ordinary Du Youwen, general who roams and strikes Sun Chaozhi, and commandant of the long water Du Shuwen were executed, and a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 七月戊子夜，帝殞於仁壽殿，時年十五。

translations.literal: On the night of wuzi day in the seventh month the emperor perished in the Hall of Benevolent Longevity; he was fifteen years of age.
translations.idiomatic: On the night of wuzi day in the seventh month the emperor died in the Hall of Benevolent Longevity at the age of fifteen.

sentences.zh: 己丑，皇太后令曰：

translations.literal: On jichou day the empress dowager issued an order, saying:
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day the empress dowager issued an order that read:

sentences.zh: 衞將軍、領軍、中書監、八座：昱以冢嫡，嗣登皇統，庶其體識日弘，社稷有寄。

translations.literal: General of the Guard, Army Commander, Supervisor of the Secretariat, and the Eight Counselors: Yu, as eldest son of the deceased, succeeded to the imperial succession; it was hoped his understanding would daily expand and the altars of state find support.
translations.idiomatic: General of the Guard, army commander, supervisor of the secretariat, and the Eight Counselors: Yu, as eldest son of the deceased emperor, succeeded to the throne; it was hoped his understanding would daily broaden and the altars of state find a worthy keeper.

sentences.zh: 豈意窮凶極悖，自幼而長，善無細而不違，惡有大而必蹈。

translations.literal: Who could have thought him utterly vicious and extreme in perversity—growing from childhood, he would violate the smallest good and invariably commit the greatest evil.
translations.idiomatic: Who could have imagined such utter viciousness and extreme perversity—from childhood he violated the smallest virtue and invariably committed the greatest wickedness.

sentences.zh: 前後訓誘，常加隱蔽，險戾難移，日月滋甚。

translations.literal: Admonition and instruction before and after were constantly concealed; his perversity and fierceness could not be moved, and day by day it grew worse.
translations.idiomatic: Admonition and instruction were constantly kept hidden; his perversity and fierceness proved immovable, and day by day it grew worse.

sentences.zh: 棄冠毀冕，長襲戎衣，犬馬是狎，鷹隼是愛，皁歷軒殿之中，韝緤宸扆之側。

translations.literal: He cast off cap and crown and long wore military garb; he doted on dogs and horses and loved hawks and falcons; black boots trod the imperial halls, and falconers' gloves hung beside the imperial throne.
translations.idiomatic: He cast off cap and crown and constantly wore military garb; he doted on dogs and horses and loved hawks and falcons; black boots trampled the imperial halls, and falconers' gloves hung beside the throne.

sentences.zh: 至乃單騎遠郊，獨宿深野，手揮矛鋋，躬行刳斮，白刃為弄器，斬害為恒務。
